origin.description: Theil's entropy measure, or his second measure when the parameter is not 0.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric vector. The measures are defined for non-negative values.

arguments.name: parameter
arguments.text: NULL uses 0, which is Theil's entropy measure. Any other value selects the second measure.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If true, drop missing values first. If false, any missing value makes the result missing.

origin.details: Parameter 0 drops exact zeros, then computes sum(x * log(x / mean(x))) / sum(x). Every other parameter is the gap between the log of the arithmetic mean and the mean of the logs.

translation.description: Theil's entropy measure, or his second measure when the parameter is not 0.

translation.example:
from ineq.measures import Theil

# generate vector (of incomes)
x = [541, 1463, 2445, 3438, 4437, 5401, 6392, 8304, 11904, 22261]
print(Theil(x))
